name: Puzzle Platformer
description: Traversal where the level itself is the opponent: read the room, change its state, then cross it. The pack layers stateful machinery — switches, weighted plates, crates, doors, teleporters — over the platformer kit, plus rewind as the genre's signature mercy. Wiring is channel-based throughout, so puzzles are data: rearranging the room never rewrites the logic. Platformer-pack components are reused here as members, not reintroduced.
loop: observe → manipulate world state → traverse → exit

signatureCompound.name: Crate, Plate, Door
signatureCompound.description: The minimal proof of the loop: a crate-only pressure plate holds a door open, the player must push the block onto it and cross before anything disturbs the arrangement — with rewind as the undo when the crate falls in a pit. Switch, plate, block, and door all talk over named channels, demonstrating that the puzzle is wiring, not bespoke code.
